disclaimer.short: PetCare organises the information you enter. It does not diagnose and does not replace your veterinarian.
disclaimer.full: PetCare is an organiser, not a medical tool. It stores and reminds you of the information you enter (visits, vaccinations, treatments, weight…). It never makes a diagnosis, never suggests a dosage and never sets a vaccination schedule: those decisions belong to your veterinarian. In an emergency, contact a vet immediately.
disclaimer.export: Summary generated by PetCare from information entered by the owner. Not a medical document and not a substitute for veterinary records.

premium.title: PetCare Premium
premium.pitch: Unlimited pets, full history, exports and no ads.
premium.headline: Care without limits
premium.petLimit: The free version includes up to {{count}} pets. Your data is never deleted.

benefits.exports: PDF health summaries and CSV exports

premium.pendingBody: Premium will unlock once Google Play confirms the payment.
premium.errorBody: No payment was taken. Please try again later.
premium.unavailableBody: Subscriptions can't be loaded right now (offline or store not configured). All free features keep working.
premium.legal: Payment is handled by Google Play. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, from Play Store › Subscriptions. Lifetime is a one-time purchase.
premium.statsBody: Yearly chart, category breakdown, budget and CSV export with Premium.
premium.historyHiddenBody: Nothing is deleted. Premium shows your full history.

storage.title: Stored on your phone
storage.body: Pet profiles, health records, reminders and expenses are kept in a local database on this phone. PetCare has no server and no account.

files.title: Photos and documents
files.body: Files you add are copied into PetCare's private folder. They are never uploaded. Exports are created only when you ask and temporary copies are deleted afterwards.

ads.title: Advertising
ads.body: The free version shows a small non-personalised banner on browsing screens only, never on health records, treatments or documents. No pet or health data is ever shared with the ad network.

analytics.title: Statistics
analytics.body: Anonymous usage statistics are off by default. When enabled they only include generic events (e.g. “a record was added”), never names, notes or medical data.

notifications.title: Reminders
notifications.body: Reminders are scheduled locally by Android. No push service is used.

rights.title: Your control
rights.body: You can export a backup at any time and delete all your data from Settings › Backup & data.

medical.title: Not a medical tool
medical.body: PetCare organises what you enter. It does not diagnose, prescribe or replace your veterinarian.
